parties: Quardra Medical Services Ltd; Bandhan Bank Limited
headline: Quardra Medical Services Ltd discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Quardra Medical Services Ltd has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material stake acquisition in Bandhan Bank Limited.
implication: The 31(4) disclosure (post-acquisition announcement) triggers public scrutiny and potential regulatory review of the acquirer's fit-and-proper status, shareholding pattern, and governance intent—a critical gating point for BFSI consolidation in India.
detail: Quardra Medical Services Ltd has submitted a mandatory disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code following a substantial acquisition of shares in Bandhan Bank Limited. The disclosure initiates the formal takeover regulation compliance process. The specific acquisition size, valuation and timeline are not disclosed in the primary filing excerpt; corroborating sources are required to establish consideration and structural details. Such acquisitions in the banking sector are subject to RBI approval under banking regulation law.
